FRONTIER DIGITAL VENTURES LTD
This is the detailed information about FRONTIER DIGITAL VENTURES LTD, it was

company’s status is listed as “REGD” now.
FRONTIER DIGITAL VENTURES LTD has been operating for 4 year 10 month 5
days.
Note:
Type: specifies the type of company;

Date format: YYYY/MM/DD;
State Registration Number: registration number assigned when originally registered
by the state;
ABN: if company has an ABN, then show ABN, else show 0;
Current Name Indicator: flag indicating whether the company name shown is the
current company name(Y/Null).
